fano_note: F7 has 7 vertices: every 3-graph on <=6 vertices is Fano-free by vertex count, so pair-free = K4-free at order <=6 (proof, no enumeration needed).
consequence: Any flag SDP of order <=6 for {F7,K4} equals the K4-alone SDP; known ceiling 0.561666 > 5/9 cannot close the target. Order >=7 flags are required.
